content.text: Spring Batch allows you to hook into different execution events using listeners. These listeners can run custom logic before/after key batch operations such as reading, writing, processing, step execution, and job execution.
There are three main categories of listeners:

rows: Listen to step-level events (chunk, read, write, process, etc.)

items: Trigger actions before a job starts and after a job ends.
Receive notifications regardless of job success or failure.
Must be registered on the Job.

content.text: Respond to events occurring within a Step.
Spring Batch provides multiple interfaces depending on which lifecycle stage you want to react to.

rows: Before/after reading an item or when read fails
Before/after processing an item or when processing fails
Before/after writing items or when writing fails
When an item is skipped in read/process/write

content.text: Spring Batch supports repeat and retry logic for robust item processing.
These listeners help track retries, failures, and repeat attempts.
Used for events in the repeat template (chunk processing).
Used for retryable operations (e.g., transient network failures).

rows: ItemReadListener, ItemProcessListener, ItemWriteListener, SkipListener, ChunkListener, StepExecutionListener
